statement: The project is an unbranded OCD-style overdrive clone (v0.1), not branded as Fulltone/OCD.
Target supply is 5–18V DC center-negative and true bypass is required.
OCD-style reference topology uses TL082 dual op-amp gain stages with MOSFET+Ge asymmetric clipping referenced to a floating Vref (~Vcc/2) in common v1.4+ implementations.
conditions: v1.4-style reference; exact component values revision-dependent

statement: OCD soft-slope clipping character should be attributed primarily to topology (series resistor + floating Vref network), not to an intrinsically softer 2N7000 body diode.
For complex musical signals, asymmetric clipping explanations must not reduce to a simple even-harmonics-equals-warm rule; IMD and waveform/envelope behavior matter.
Increasing single-supply voltage (e.g., 9V to 18V) increases available op-amp swing/headroom around Vref, all else equal.
conditions: single-supply Vref-biased op-amp stages; device limits apply
locator: general op-amp headroom; verify per TL082 datasheet limits

statement: TL082 suitability for 5V single-supply operation in this v0.1 topology is unverified and a critical risk.
locator: TI TL082 product/datasheet (SLOS081O) - limits to be extracted

statement: Vref divider example (ideal) 100k/100k at 9V yields 4.5V with Thevenin resistance ~50k.

Genuine 1N34A germanium diodes are variable and often hard to source reliably; Schottky diodes (e.g., BAT41/BAT46) are common substitutes in some designs but have different Vf/leakage and may alter clipping character.
2N7000 and TL082 are generally readily available through major distributors in common packages; availability still depends on chosen package/vendor and should be checked at BOM time.

TI TL082 product parametric summary (S007, opened 2026-11-09) indicates total supply min 7V, input common-mode headroom to negative supply typ 3V, output swing headroom typ 1.5V per rail; exact conditions must be verified in SLOS081O.
conditions: TI product page parametric summary; verify in SLOS081O tables

statement: 2N7000 TO-92 pinout is commonly Source/Gate/Drain (1/2/3) for Fairchild-origin devices; onsemi support response cited by secondary source indicates S=1,D=3 for their marking context, but onsemi datasheet pinout confusion has been reported. Pinout MUST be verified against the exact manufacturer datasheet/package before PCB/simulation mapping.
